title: Creation Day 1: light
note: First day of the creation week, three days before the calendar's first Nisan 1.

title: Creation Day 4: sun, moon and stars — the calendar begins
note: The luminaries are made 'for signs and seasons, days and years'; the DSS calendar counts from this Wednesday.

title: Creation Day 7: the first Sabbath
note: God rests on the seventh day and blesses it.

title: Abraham born
note: Year from the Genesis 11 genealogy; the day is the one given by dsscalendar.org.

title: Covenant with Abraham established
note: 430 years to the day before the Exodus.

title: Year 6000 AM begins
note: Close of the 12th Onah and the Age of Grace in this calendar's scheme.

title: First year of the Age of the Kingdom (6001 AM)
note: Start of the 13th Onah in this calendar's scheme.

title: Six days before Passover: Jesus anointed at Bethany
note: Six days before the Passover of Thursday Nisan 14 (Ken Johnson).
basis: Ken Johnson's dates (Jewish lunar reckoning), civil date counted from his April 6, AD 32

title: Triumphal entry: Daniel's 69 weeks fulfilled
note: Ken Johnson: the 69 weeks of Daniel 9 (from Artaxerxes' decree, Nisan 444 BC) end 'exactly on the day', April 6, AD 32; Jesus leaves Bethany on Nisan 10.

title: "After two days is the passover": the plot to kill Jesus
note: Two days before Passover (Ken Johnson's Thursday Nisan 14).
basis: Ken Johnson's dates (Jewish lunar reckoning), civil date counted from his April 6, AD 32

title: Crucifixion: the Messiah dies at Passover
note: Ken Johnson: Thursday, Nisan 14, the preparation day, AD 32 (3957 AM); on the cross from 9 am, died at 3 pm.
basis: Ken Johnson's dates (Jewish lunar reckoning), civil date counted from his April 6, AD 32

title: Resurrection of Jesus
note: Ken Johnson: Sunday, Nisan 17, First Fruits that year. On the Dead Sea Scroll calendar this Sunday is 26 Nisan, the First Fruits of the Barley.
basis: Ken Johnson's dates (Jewish lunar reckoning), civil date counted from his April 6, AD 32
